skill.summary: Run only when the user explicitly asks for a fleet-wide Azure Key Vault health check — pulse check for availability, API latency, throttling (429s), auth fai...

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of amg-check-key-vault skill.
- Performs explicit, on-demand fleet-wide Azure Key Vault health checks: API availability, latency, throttling, auth failures, and saturation.
- Auto-discovers all Key Vaults and summarizes by region and SKU.
- Deep-dives into the top 7 most interesting vaults based on health signals for detailed metric and log analysis.
- Tracks known issues across sessions with a persistent report.
- Includes comprehensive setup guidance and automatic detection of required Azure Monitor datasource and subscription.
